status: actual-source normalization, reverse complete-cell turn, and exact bare-centre symmetry proved; joined current sign open

source_phase.normalizer: The common source normalizer is nu=eta/S_a=omega_c/(B_0T_0), where omega_c=(-1)^N eta and eta=phi(1+d_1)/|1+d_1|. At xi=Omega one has c_xi=1, |nu|=(B_0T_0)^(-1), and exp(2i gamma_phys)=eta^2; cutoff parity cancels from the transpose phase.
source_phase.continuous_phase: Because M_t(s) is nonzero and |d_1|<1/2, choose continuous unwrapped beta_t=arg M_t(s), delta_1=arg(1+d_1), theta_eta=beta_t+delta_1, and chi_N=phi_N+theta_eta on each complete fixed-N q=1 cell.
source_phase.stationary_lock: For Q(v)=exp(i[v log(v/(2pi))-v-pi/4]) and gamma_t=conjugate(M_t)/M_t=exp(-2i beta_t), Section 11.119 supplies the continuous psi=arg(Q(Omega)/gamma_t), with |psi|<1/x. Hence arg Q(Omega)+2beta_t=psi exactly on the chosen lift.

reverse_turn.lock_identity: Let K_N=2pi N^2 and F_N(v)=v[1+log(K_N/v)]. The stationary lock gives the exact unwrapped identity 2chi_N=F_N(Omega)+pi/4+psi+2delta_1.
reverse_turn.endpoint_identity: At the ideal cutoff endpoints Omega=2pi N^2 and 2pi(N+1)^2, the increment of 2chi_N is 2pi G_N, where G_N=(N+1)^2[1-2log(1+1/N)]-N^2.
reverse_turn.ideal_decrement: Put u=1/N. The alternating lower bound log(1+u)>=u-u^2/2+u^3/3-u^4/4 yields G_N<=-2-(7/16)u. Thus the ideal increment obeys Delta(2chi_N)<=-4pi-7pi/(8N).
reverse_turn.endpoint_scale: At an endpoint with a=m>=2, x=4pi[m^2-1/(32L^2)]>9m^2, using pi>3. Also N>=ceil(a(50))>2^25 because e>2.
reverse_turn.physical_error: Replacing the ideal endpoint frequencies by Omega=2pi a^2-epsilon contributes less than 1/N^2 to Delta F_N. The lock phases contribute |Delta psi|<2/(9N^2). Since |arg(1+d_1)|<2|d_1|<4378/x, the term 2Delta delta_1 contributes less than 17512/(9N^2). The total perturbation of Delta(2chi_N) is therefore less than 1947/N^2.
reverse_turn.reverse_turn: Since 1947/N^2<7pi/(8N) for N>2^25, every complete physical q=1 cell satisfies Delta chi_N<-2pi. Moreover Delta chi_N tends to -2pi as N tends to infinity.
reverse_turn.absolute_circle: The continuous absolute terminal carrier eta exp(i phi_N)=exp(i chi_N) covers the full unit circle on every complete cell, now in the reverse direction. This is source-inclusive and is distinct from the much faster positive winding of exp(i phi_N).
reverse_turn.phase_inventory: The previous Delta phi_N>2pi and the new Delta chi_N<-2pi imply Delta theta_eta=Delta chi_N-Delta phi_N<-4pi. The transpose phase phi_N+2theta_eta=2chi_N-phi_N has increment below -6pi. Thus the terminal, source, absolute-terminal, and transpose phases all cover the circle; their correlations, not a fixed sector, are the remaining content.

centre_symmetry.anchor_ratio: For b=log N, d=log(a^2/N)=b+2u_N, the raw anchors satisfy A_H/A_T=d/b=1+2u_N/b and A_H-A_T=D_N b d u_N/(2pi)>=0.
centre_symmetry.actual_current: At xi=Omega, write tau_0=rho exp(i[phi_N-pi/2]), rho>0. The actual-source raw-centre current is R_center=-(rho|nu|^2/2)[A_H sin(phi_N)+A_T sin(phi_N+2theta_eta)].
centre_symmetry.symmetry_factorization: The two-channel centre has the exact saddle symmetry R_center=-rho|nu|^2 A_T[cos(theta_eta)sin(phi_N+theta_eta)+(u_N/b)sin(phi_N)]. The first term couples the source phase to the source-inclusive absolute terminal phase chi_N; the second is the exact Hermitian/transpose anchor mismatch.
centre_symmetry.branch_free: Equivalently, R_center=-rho|nu|^2 A_T[Re(eta)Im(eta exp(i phi_N))+(u_N/b)Im(exp(i phi_N))]. Choosing omega_c=(-1)^Neta instead gives the same product, so this form is parity invariant and branch free.
centre_symmetry.mismatch_bound: Across a complete cell, 0<=u_N<=log(1+1/N)<1/N and b=log N>1/2, hence 0<=u_N/b<2/N. The raw centres are therefore an extremely close equal-anchor pair, but this small coefficient does not control the current near zeros of Re(eta) or Im(eta exp(i phi_N)).
centre_symmetry.tie_guard: D_N changes at internal odd-roster ties. The ratio and factorization hold on both adjacent raw-centre charts, but the centre is not itself a tie-invariant physical observable. Any sign theorem must restore the reciprocal residual, terminal survivor, correction rows, affine row, and moved-tail defect before crossing a tie.
centre_symmetry.open_correlation: The next falsifiable centre-level question is whether the Xi-specific joint path (Re eta, Im[eta exp(i phi_N)]) has a signed product budget strong enough to dominate the O(u_N/log N) mismatch on roster interiors. Circle coverage of either factor separately cannot answer it.
